description: Accounting contacts linking a sevdesk contact to its debitor and creditor account numbers.

contact_id.description: Id of the contact whose accounting contact you want. Sent as the bracketed query key contact[id]; send together with contact_object_name.

contact_object_name.description: Object name of the contact filter. Sent as the bracketed query key contact[objectName]; only needed when contact_id is also given. Use 'Contact'.

objects.description: Page of accounting contacts. sevdesk wraps every list response in a top-level 'objects' array.

id.description: The accounting contact id. Read-only; a numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire (example '0'). Primary key, and the value taken by PUT/DELETE as the {accounting_contact_id} path segment.

objectName.description: The accounting contact object name; read-only, example 'AccountingContact'. Constant in practice, but the provider declares no enum, so no closed value domain is asserted.

create.description: Date of accounting contact creation; read-only. Provider-wide system field. Wire values carry an explicit offset (e.g. 2024-06-28T14:42:58+02:00) -> zone-aware.

update.description: Date of last accounting contact update; read-only. Provider-wide system field. Wire values carry an explicit offset (e.g. 2024-06-28T14:42:58+02:00) -> zone-aware. NOT usable as an incremental cursor: GET /AccountingContact exposes no modified-after filter param.

contact.description: The contact to which this accounting contact belongs. sevdesk relation object ({id, objectName='Contact'}); read-only. Opaque JSON.

sevClient.description: Client to which the accounting contact belongs; filled automatically by sevdesk. Relation object ({id, objectName='SevClient'}); read-only. Opaque JSON.

debitorNumber.description: Debitor number (receivable account number). Read model declares type string with example '0' - a numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire; genuine integer on write.

creditorNumber.description: Creditor number (vendor account number). Read model declares type string with example '0' - a numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire; genuine integer on write.

schema.description: Model_AccountingContact: one accounting contact to create. Relation ids are integers on the request side, unlike the string ids the read side returns.

contact.description: The contact this accounting contact belongs to. Required on create and not nullable.

debitorNumber.description: Debitor number (receivable account number). Genuine integer on write, string on read.

creditorNumber.description: Creditor number (vendor account number). Genuine integer on write, string on read.

schema.description: Model_AccountingContactUpdate: every field is optional except the id that addresses the row. PUT /AccountingContact/{accounting_contact_id} updates only - an unknown id is not a create. Provider warning: updating an existing AccountingContact can lead to booking errors, especially in the DATEV export.

id.description: Id of the accounting contact to update; supplies the {accounting_contact_id} path segment. Integer on the wire, serialized as a string on the read side.

contact.description: The contact this accounting contact belongs to. Optional and nullable on update (partial update).

debitorNumber.description: Debitor number (receivable account number). Genuine integer on write, string on read.

creditorNumber.description: Creditor number (vendor account number). Genuine integer on write, string on read.
